decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo printer builds on our existing inkjet and printhead control capabilities, enabling us to interpret early results and improve it, so we keep it.
The software module extends our existing software portfolio for digital variable-data printing and fits our digitalization strategy, so we keep it.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces leverages our core inkjet and ink expertise, allowing us to assimilate feedback and refine the product, so we keep it.
